thread:
maria_g: FYI we received a DSAR erase request from an EU user (case #EU-902). They asked full deletion including embeddings + convo logs. Legal flagged a potential retention exception for an audit. Need technical plan for keystore + snapshots. @legal-team
legal-team: We have identity proof and an internal audit hold request. Creating hold ID HLD-902. Hold might persist for ~72h. For now please prepare deletion artifacts but don't actually delete until we update.
raj_patel: Understood. We should prepare a forensics-friendly proof of what would be deleted. Also check any active incident or vuln triage referencing this user.
sophie: Quick checks: user has snapshots in two regions. One snapshot in eu-west1 encrypted with gcp-kms key projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/key-prod-01. Others in us-central1.
alex_k: There's an old backfill snapshot flagged orphaned with unknown key version. Might block delete verification.
maria_g: Proposed steps: 1) Freeze user writes (feature flag) 2) Create short-lived custodian role for keystore ops with timebound RBAC and explicit audit reason 3) Rewrap EU snapshot to ephemeral key 4) Run verify -> produce signed proof JSON 5) Upload proof to private S3 and share with Legal 6) If hold removed, run deletion job and record receipts; if hold persists, keep snapshots and attach proof.
infra-oncall: I can create role ad-hoc:custodian:HLD-902 and grant to infra-oncall SA for 45m. Will include audit label `reason=DSAR-HLD-902`. Who are approvers?
raj_patel: Approvers: @sophie + @alex_k. Add both approvers to the RBAC change request.
sophie: Approved. Keep grant minimal: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on ephemeral key only. No broad keystore-owner.
alex_k: Ephemeral key must be HSM-backed and TTL 1h. Also we need to snapshot S3 object listing before any operation for chain-of-custody. Run `s3 ls` and attach output.
infra-oncall: Granting now. Audit entry: https://audit.internal/entries/hld-902-grant :lock:
infra-oncall: Rewrap command executed:
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=ephemeral-hld-902 --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ephemeral-rg
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/keyR1 --member=serviceAccount:infra-oncall@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
keystore rewrap --snapshot=snap-eu-902 --to-key=projects/redwood/locations/eu-west1/ephemeral-hld-902 --ephemeral-ttl=1h
```
infra-oncall: Rewrap completed, ran `keystore verify --snapshot snap-eu-902 --proof-out=HLD-902-proof.json`, proof uploaded to `s3://priv-proofs/HLD-902/` :white_check_mark:
maria_g: Verified proof file, shared with Legal. Captured S3 listing before ops and after. Kept original snapshot object but marked in metadata `hold:HLD-902`.
alex_k: Note: if rewrap failed with permission denied, fallback would be manual re-encryption by keystore-admins and escalate. But happy path completed.
legal-team: We have the proof and audit entries. Hold remains for now; do not delete. Please open retention-exception ticket for Finance/Operations: PRIV-TCK-224.
raj_patel: I'll add a follow-up to automate the ad-hoc role path in runbooks to avoid manual approvers each time. Also add a test case for orphaned snapshot rewrap.
sophie: Add runbook item: verify rewrap proof includes key fingerprint, KMS version, and signed timestamp.
maria_g: Closing ops here: no deletion performed while HLD-902 active. Will follow up when Legal lifts the hold. Thanks all.
security-bot: Vault log: HLD-902 artifacts saved.
